Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE landscape1536x1024 photograph to be used as the background of an editorial Instagram carousel for Brazilian parents. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark anywhere.
Top-down overhead view of a pale wooden study table in warm daylight. A large rectangular sheet of warm white paper lies completely FLAT and aligned horizontally with the image, occupying roughly x=9% to60%, y=12% to89%. Keep the CENTRAL TOP TWO THIRDS of this sheet completely BLANK so a fictional school assignment can be typeset later. At the lower right corner of the paper rests a real magnifying glass with a dark navy handle, with the glass over blank paper, not over any writing. A blue spiral notebook is partially visible on the right side of the image; open empty ruled pages. A yellow pencil beside it. At lower left, a small relaxed hand belonging to a fictional 11-year-old girl with medium brown skin and a burgundy long sleeve rests at the edge of the table, NOT covering the central blank sheet.
The image should look like the start of an ordinary school task at home, tactile paper, realistic desk and human hand. Not an official certificate, no teacher name, grade, stamps or fabricated school logos. Editorial composition, straight overhead view to allow accurate text overlay in editing. No perspective distortion of the main paper. Blank paper is deliberate.

No AI writing, numbers, ticks, arrows, stamps or logos.

LEFT sketch: a simple friendly tiny round-headed explorer with a blue cap and yellow backpack WALKING right on a horizontal green ground line. Two faint pencil ghost poses behind him and a large clean blue rightward arrow clarify walking. No obstacles in this left scene.
RIGHT sketch: the SAME explorer at the same ground level, now stopped before ONE low rectangular grey stone obstacle on the path. A hand-drawn yellow circle around the stone emphasizes that this is a separate addition. No ghost poses or arrow crossing the rock, no jumping. One short graphite baseline under each scene.
Separate the two sketches clearly with generous white gutter and a thin subtle vertical pencil divider. Top of each panel has a blank strip for labels to be applied in editing, do not write any labels. Two distinct tasks, one movement, one obstacle. Big readable forms, lots of clean paper around them, no decorative scenery, no text-filled placeholder.
